report.title: 2025 Consumer Confidence Report - Oak Dell Park

sources_described: Ground Water: Well 02 (002_002), located off Watsonville Rd, in Morgan Hill, Ca. Drinking water source assessment available by request.

extraction_notes: The EAR portal serves this CCR only as a Word .docx (saved as reports/CA4300603/ccr-2025.docx, format docx); text and tables were read from word/document.xml with python3 -I. Page numbers are taken from Word's lastRenderedPageBreak markers (8 rendered pages) and may differ by one from a fresh print. Table 6 (unregulated), Table 7 (violations) and Table 9 (groundwater TT violations) are printed 'None'. Copper appears three times (Table 2 tap 90th percentile 0.038 ppm; Table 4 and Table 5 rows both 0.004 ppm from 6/21/2024); all kept with id 'copper' and the non-tap rows flagged in value_basis. Iron, manganese and color have separate pre-treatment and post-treatment rows. Lead service line inventory: no lead service lines.
